article.headline: Christian Gurdak, Jamichael Davis spark Rutgers to 72-51 victory over Bryant
article.description: — Christian Gurdak scored a career-high 20 points while pulling down 14 rebounds, and Jamichael Davis added 18 points off the bench to help Rutgers overcome a sluggish start in a 72-51 victory over Bryant on Friday night.
article.linkText: Christian Gurdak, Jamichael Davis spark Rutgers to 72-51 victory over Bryant

article.story: PISCATAWAY, N.J. -- — Christian Gurdak scored a career-high 20 points while pulling down 14 rebounds, and Jamichael Davis added 18 points off the bench to help Rutgers overcome a sluggish start in a 72-51 victory over Bryant on Friday night. Gurdak, a 6-foot-10 sophomore, made 8 of 11 shots and all four of his free throws for the Scarlet Knights (3-0). Davis went 4 for 5 from 3-point range and 4 for 4 at the foul line. Lino Mark added 12 points and eight rebounds for Rutgers. Roi Behar sank five 3-pointers and scored 19 to lead the Bulldogs (1-4). Keegan Harvey contributed 10 points and seven rebounds. Rutgers led by 11 when Behar buried Bryant's first 3-pointer after 10 straight misses, and the Bulldogs made five of their next seven from distance to get within 35-31 at halftime. Andre Pasha had baskets on both sides of a three-point play by Harvey and Bryant scored the first seven points of the second half for a 38-35 lead. Mark had a three-point play and Davis scored five in a 10-0 run as Rutgers took the lead and never looked back. The Scarlet Knights shot 43% overall, made 4 of 11 from distance, and 20 of 28 at the foul line. The Bulldogs shot 34%, made only 9 of 37 from distance and missed 5 of 7 free throws. Up next Bryant: At Massachusetts on Tuesday.
